ratings.justification: feature-disabled: Outgoing query source-port entropy weakened where upstream load balancing depends on it: cache poisoning of the site's recursive resolver. unbound on the firewall is a full recursive resolver for every zone (forwards only internal and 10.in-addr.arpa to dnsmasq), so any internal client looking up an attacker's domain makes unbound read the attacker's own DNS server's responses.

ratings.justification: feature-disabled: Heap overflow in RRSet canonicalisation from a 255-byte query name and a large TCP response. unbound on the firewall is a full recursive resolver for every zone (forwards only internal and 10.in-addr.arpa to dnsmasq), so any internal client looking up an attacker's domain makes unbound read the attacker's own DNS server's responses. Fixed in unbound 1.26.1; OPNsense 26.1.11_10 ships 1.25.1 and its channel offers nothing newer yet.
